_about: Two more official findings (strong matches), found by a research pass on 28 October 2026 that never opened an audit run. Written down and committed together with the clearance rules of 28 October (7114509) before any verdict on them was looked at: the only rulings that test those rules. Quotes checked against the GMA article's text. 25CC0063: the article lists the site as Purok 2; the contract record says Purok 3, and it is the only SYMS record in San Roque near P74 million. 24CC0010: no Atlas outcome is a partial build, so only a flag counts as compatible and a clearance counts against Atlas.
